description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Required for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. Call the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API to obtain the scene orchestration rule ID.

title.zh: 绑定场景联动规则到边缘实例
title.en: Attach a scene orchestration rule to an edge instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 20 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot bind-scene-rule-to-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id llL44UVXUqb9m5000000 --rule-id f041397879ad4d89822811d741000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
